rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst, but it overstates certainty about visible hatching/herniation, ICM location/definition, and cohesive TE detail that are not clearly discernible in this single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian response, prior failed cycles, endometrium, semen parameters, BMI, diagnosis, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability adjustments explained; minor issues include somewhat speculative quantitative penalties for alcohol and prior failures.

Mostly aligned on SET and general IVF counseling, but it overreaches on ERA/EMMA-ALICE, immune testing/NK cells, thrombophilia workup, and strong PGT-A recommendations in this profile, which are not uniformly guideline-supported.
Provides clear next steps for transfer management, lifestyle modification, and contingency planning, though some recommendations are more aggressive or speculative than standard practice.
